pathology.why: Flat lookup opens a full compatibility check for every active adaptation even when bounded summary conditions can exclude it.

candidate.change: Apply status, freshness, permission, contraindication, and activation conditions to bounded summaries before opening full adaptation compatibility checks.

primary_metric: Full compatibility checks with identical selection and downstream correctness.
prediction: The summary shortlist keeps every expected apply and skip while reducing full compatibility checks below flat lookup and the status-permission heuristic.
falsification_condition: Any expected adaptation is missed, any irrelevant adaptation is applied, a conflict is auto-resolved, permissions expand, or full compatibility checks do not decrease.

rollback.threshold: Rollback on one false activation, missed relevant adaptation, unsupported conflict resolution, or permission expansion.
